feature: Customer Portal v2 -- OVERVIEW (/portal-v2/overview). The tenant-health landing page. Git #1216 wired the headline stat, the scan band's real last-scan time, the drift chips' real accepted-as-risk count, and three of the six 'Everything in motion' lanes (change requests, hold windows, accepted risks) to real per-tenant data -- see overviewModel.ts's *FromLive functions. The pillar strip was already live (#1200/#1201). Evidence pack, Microsoft changes and the project schedule stay fixture -- no live producer exists for them and none was claimed. 'Fixed this week' / 'new this week' drift chips render the honest em-dash: no run-to-run finding diff exists anywhere in this platform yet.
notes: THE LOGIN BLOCK IS NOT OPTIONAL. /portal-v2/* sits behind ProtectedRoute.

UI ROUTE SHAPE: /portal/{slug}/portal-v2 (the BARE /portal-v2 route, declared before /portal-v2/:pillar in App.tsx so the index isn't swallowed by the param match -- there is no separate /portal-v2/overview path).
shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, not the local worktree -- this manifest's live-data assertions only go green once this session's commit is deployed.

LIVE, TENANT-SPECIFIC NUMBERS ARE NOT ASSERTED BY VALUE, same rule as portal-v2-copilot.json: the headline total, the accepted-as-risk count and every lane depend on the tenant's own real data, so the harness asserts an any-of STRUCTURE (which of the two honest headline sentences is on screen) and static label copy, never a specific number.

THE 'FIXED THIS WEEK' / 'NEW THIS WEEK' CHIPS ARE INTENTIONALLY UNASSERTED BY VALUE -- they render an em-dash because no backing computation exists yet (documented in overviewData.ts / overviewModel.ts's driftChips). Only their static labels are asserted.

THE THREE 'IN MOTION' LANES (cc/rb/rr) FALL BACK TO FIXTURE ON A NON-LIVE READ (fixture read failure, unscoped tenant, or -- for hold windows -- no runbooks yet), so at least one lane row is ALWAYS present in each of the three sections regardless of live vs fixture; a prefixed data-testid selector proves a row rendered without asserting whether it was live or fixture.
NO `select` STEPS. UiTestExecutor.cs cannot drive a native <select>; this page has none.

ZERO-DATA SCENE 0 LANDING (Git #1298): PortalV2ScanLanding ports RevealScanOverlay (Scene 0) as the entry point for a customer with NO scan on record -- it mounts only when scan-status confirms `!everScanned`, POSTs debug-trigger-scan for a testbed tenant / shows RevealNoScanGate for a real one, and hands off to this Overview on scan completion. The landing's own SHOWING cannot be asserted live here because the only reachable test tenant (shane-mccaw-consulting) is already scanned (everScanned=true), so the landing correctly never mounts for it. The gating decisions themselves are unit-tested (revealAutoScan.test.ts decideAutoScan, neverScannedGate.test.ts shouldBlockNeverScanned) -- PortalV2ScanLanding reuses those exact helpers unchanged. What IS asserted live below (OV16) is the regression guard: for an already-scanned tenant the ported overlay stays absent and the real Overview renders directly.
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.
